title: Earth Hour Cyclothon 2023 – Pedal for the Planet

author: Team UCC
html:
Udaipur Cycling Club participated in the Earth Hour Cyclothon 2023 – Pedal for the Planet earlier today. The event, which was organized by 60 Earth Hours and WWF, aimed to raise awareness about the importance of protecting the environment and promoting sustainable practices.

As a regional partner for the event, our club had the opportunity to showcase our commitment to promoting sustainable development and reducing carbon emissions. We are incredibly proud of all the members who participated in the Cyclothon and represented our club so well. A special shoutout to Nikhil Ranka, Nitesh Tak, HS Kumawat, Aashish Chittrora, Gaurav, Amarpreet, Mahesh Singhvi, Dr. Akansha, Dr. Nafisa, Dr. Neha, Praveen Kumar, Jayant Nanawati, Vibhash, Rachit Singhvi, and Dinesh Sharma.

Cycling is not just a sport or a means of transportation but also a powerful tool for promoting sustainable development and reducing carbon emissions. As a cycling club, we have a responsibility to raise awareness about the importance of preserving our planet for future generations. We are delighted to see our members taking this responsibility seriously and making a positive impact on our planet through their actions.

We firmly believe that events like the Earth Hour Cyclothon 2023 provide an excellent opportunity to showcase our commitment to promoting sustainable practices and protecting the environment. We are grateful to all the members who participated in the event and represented our club so well.

Once again, congratulations to all the members who participated in the Earth Hour Cyclothon 2023. Let’s continue to make a positive impact on our planet through our actions and commitment to sustainable development.
